title: Unity 6 URP project scaffold with test assemblies
summary: Create the Unity 6 project under unity/ with URP, the iOS target (Android stays buildable but is not shipped in v1), the bundle id, pinned packages, and EditMode/PlayMode test assemblies with one smoke test each, so CI can run -batchmode tests and builds.

acceptance_tests.test: Unity 6000.x LTS version pinned in unity/ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt and stated in unity/README.md; the same version is what the QA VM (M0-QA-01) installs.

URP configured with pipeline assets per quality tier for iOS (Metal, IL2CPP); bundle id com.sparkforgelabs.giganticjourneys; the Android build target stays available but off by default (v1 ships iOS only, AUTH #003).
Packages/manifest.json and Packages/packages-lock.json committed; every package pinned to an exact version; Input System, Animation Rigging, UI Toolkit, Test Framework present.

EditMode and PlayMode test assemblies exist with one passing smoke test each; `Unity -batchmode -nographics -runTests -testPlatform EditMode` and `PlayMode` pass locally (log attached) and in CI once M0-REPO-03 lands.
acceptance_tests.evidence: test logs in qa/reports/M0-UNITY-01/, CI links

acceptance_tests.test: Project opens with zero console errors on the QA VM; `git status` is clean after opening (Library/Temp ignored).

security: SECURITY_CHECKLIST §9.7 IL2CPP, symbols stripped in release

history.event: AUTH #003 applied: acceptance-criterion levels added; iOS-only wording
